rows: Graphitization of Cathode blocks in 74 pots
Replacement of 111 nos. of old motors (Ranging from 0.55 KW up to 55 KW) with energy efficient IE3 Motors
Two driers were replaced by energy efficient driers
Screw compressor was replaced with similar capacity centrifugal compressor
3 nos. of cold well pumps were replaced by 3 nos. of new energy efficient pumps
